thread:
alex: Morning team — quick async check-in.
What I did: landed kernel prefetch backoff (PR #482), added unit tests for the KV lookup hot path.
Blockers: seeing ~5–10% regression on 512-token throughput in the canary; uncertain if this is from kernel batching change or KV latencies.
Today: run targeted microbench, bisect canary, and prepare a revert PR if it's the batching change.

maria: I also noticed the noise on canary this morning. Metrics show slot-steal spikes coincident with the throughput drops. I uploaded a pprof to the telemetry channel: https://intra/docs/pprof/171333

jonathan: i can repro locally with this command:
```
./bench --model redwood-v2 --seq 512 --batch-size 8 --gpu 0 --iters 300
```
Logs show a latency spike around iter 118–125: `kv_lookup: 12.3ms -> 48.9ms` then throughput dips.

priya: thanks. quick thought — could KV eviction/warmup be thrashing the LRU during the new prefetch window? I saw a few eviction logs in canary:
```
WARN kv: evicting slot=23 reason=stale last_access=180s
DEBUG kv: prefetch miss for prefix=0x8a
```
Blocker for me: need a stable repro to validate the eviction theory.

sam: can we try toggling kv prefetch off on canary to isolate? I can flip config on pool-3: `CACHE_PREFETCH=false` and kick a smoke run.

alex: do it. queued deploy to pool-3 now. @bench-bot can you rerun the small smoke suite after the config lands?

bench-bot: deploy detected for pool-3 (cfg: CACHE_PREFETCH=false) — running smoke benchmarks (seq=512, 100 iters).
Results (median tok/s, p99 latency):
```
before: 1250 tok/s, p99 210ms
after: 1430 tok/s, p99 184ms
delta: +14.4% throughput, -12.4% p99
```
Note: small sample; recommend 3 full runs to be confident.

maria: nice. if that delta holds across repeats, prefetch backoff is likely the culprit. i'm going to add a microbenchmark in the perf-suite that triggers prefix-heavy traffic.

jonathan: pushing a draft PR that reduces max batching delay (from 8ms -> 5ms) and adds a defensive check around kv lookup timeouts. PR: https://git/repo/pull/504 — cc @alex @priya

priya: will review today. if the KV-prefetch toggle fixes it, we should consider a short rollback for the prefetch change and re-introduce with a more conservative window.

alex: agreed. plan: (1) repeat bench runs x3 tonight, (2) if consistent, revert prefetch change on canary and keep batching tweak in staging-only for now, (3) open an investigation ticket for KV eviction/warmup patterns.

sam: FYI infra scheduled a full sweep Friday overnight. try to finish experiments by 17:00 PT Friday so we have baseline before the sweep. :calendar:

maria: i'll create the perf ticket and add the flame graphs & a couple of traces. tagging the bandwidth-sensitive endpoints.

jonathan: quick code-review ping for PR #504 — left comments on the batching window and a unit test suggestion. nothing blocking.

priya: ack, will look after standup. for the eviction repro: alex, can you paste the canary cfg (kv size, warmup policy)?

alex: pasted config below:
```
KV_POOL_SIZE=64
CACHE_PREFETCH=true (canary old)
WARMUP_POLICY=gradual-10pct
EVICTION_THRESHOLD=0.8
```
I'll attach the full YAML to the ticket.

maria: thanks. small one — if anyone sees flaky p99 on other models, drop the trace in #eng-runtime-telemetry please. short logs are most helpful right now. :+1:

bench-bot: scheduled 2 more runs at +10m and +30m; will post aggregated numbers.

alex: thanks everyone. ping here with any new odd traces; otherwise i'll update the ticket with run results tonight.
